newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu closes slightly down at 7,210/250.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu closes slightly down at 7,210/250.

text.p: The Romanian leu currency closed nearly flat at 7,210/250 to the dollar, from 7,200/250 in early trading on a quiet interbank market, traders said on Friday.

* Dealers said dollar demand picked up as some clients needed hard currency for consumer goods imports. Exporters hung on to their dollars, expecting fresh leu lows. Traders said the leu might fall marginally against the dollar next week, when the central bank (BNR) was expected to continue recent moves to buy dollars to prevent the leu from firming.

* Operators predicted higher dollar demand at money exchange bureaux would also put pressure on the leu. They expected Romanians to turn some of their leu savings into greenbacks, following cuts in banks' interest rates reflecting a recent relaxation in the BNR's monetary policy.
* Leu-dollar retail prices bobbed at 7,400/700 on Friday, weaker than 7,200/300 earlier in the week.

* Short-term money market rates hovered at about 43 percent, unchanged from morning levels. Traders said the BNR stayed away from the market on Friday. The money market is expected to move in line with the BNR's further steps to mop up excess leu liquidities, and to take leu deposits from commercial banks.
